entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the order number?
Yes, it's under Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF-771-98B. It's for the helmet I bought a couple of months ago.
Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Ride Helmet, delivered about 83 days ago. Can you tell me what the issue is?

Well, it was a gift, you see. The color just wasn't right for my partner. He's so picky. We never even opened it; the box is completely unopened. I feel terrible, and honestly, I really needed this money back for other things.

I completely understand. Getting the color and fit right is a big part of rider safety, since we want to make sure it's something they'll be happy to wear every time. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I was just hoping you could help me out.

And we appreciate that, Sarah. Okay, good news. I've checked our policy, and since the helmet is within the 90-day return window and still in its original packaging, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful. I was so worried. Thank you so much.

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help, Charlie. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
